_readme: Institution structure. The DEMO COURSE is CSW2 -- Computer Science Workshop 2,
semester 4, CSE core, admission batches 2024 and 2025. Its corpus is the real
ingested 'Django 5 By Example' plus the seven assignment PDFs the admin uploads
CSW1 is its prerequisite. The diagnostic checks what a student should already
have from it -- Python, HTTP, HTML, relational data -- which is why every gap
names CSW1 as the course it should have been learned in.
PH101/PH000 are still in the database from the earlier physics stand-in. They
are harmless: retrieval, the diagnostic and the heatmap are all course-scoped.
